item.title: Top Ways to Ensure Unicode Awareness in MySQL Queries
item.description:
Exploring Best Practices for Unicode Awareness in MySQL Queries

In the pursuit of efficient database management, particularly when handling Unicode, a frequent question among developers is regarding the use of the SET NAMES command in MySQL. A compelling excerpt from the book High Performance MySQL by O’Reilly raises an important point:

“Another common garbage query is SET NAMES UTF8, which is the wrong way to do things anyway (it does not change the client library’s character set; it affects only the server).”

item.title: Solved: How to Format MySQL Datetime to Custom Formats with PHP
item.description:
